redCandidate.setup: Player uses evolved repair regeneration, receives damage, then is attached by an opponent repair jammer.
redCandidate.expected: Health remains 60 during the jammer's two completed target turns, then restores to 80 after expiry.
redCandidate.observed: Health was 80 at the first blocked regeneration check.
redCandidate.failureReason: ProcessRepairEffectsForActiveTurn restores health without consulting the jammer status.
